source: Existing public homepage photograph of the driver and Formula SAE car
method: Alpha-only vector reveal traced from the existing photograph; source pixels are not stored or painted in the SVG
composition: Same responsive source and crop in two aligned HTML images; background fades separately, foreground keeps original color and contrast
subject: The real car, driver, helmet, roll hoop, suspension and tires; open spaces retain transparent alpha; source contact shadow fades softly
limits: Visual masks are presentational, not geometry measurements or engineering evidence. No synthetic scene, vehicle part or performance result is introduced.
immutability: New dated mask path; old raster photograph assets remain byte-identical.
